groups.title: Wildlife Removal
groups.summary: Professional wildlife removal with full exclusion work designed to permanently stop attic intrusions.
groups.intro: Our wildlife inspections identify active wildlife, entry points, nesting areas and the conditions letting animals into the structure. From removal and trapping to professional exclusion, we address the activity and how wildlife is getting inside.

services.title: Raccoon Removal
services.text: Raccoon removal takes more than trapping. We find the active areas and how raccoons are getting in, then recommend removal and exclusion based on what the inspection shows.
points: Rooflines, vents and other vulnerable areas checked

services.title: Squirrel Removal
services.text: Squirrels chew wiring, damage insulation and nest in attics. We find active areas, entry points and nesting, then use removal and exclusion to secure the access points.

services.title: Rat and Mice Removal
services.text: Rodents travel through attics and walls before most homeowners notice. We find active areas and entry points, then use rodent control and exclusion based on our findings.
points: Follow-ups typically every 3 to 5 days while activity is being resolved

services.title: Bat Removal
services.text: Bat removal takes a specialized approach and must follow applicable wildlife regulations. We find bat activity and access points and perform exclusion based on the conditions at the property.

services.title: Opossum Removal
services.text: Opossums get into attics and crawl spaces looking for shelter, leaving droppings, odors and disturbed insulation. We find the access points and recommend the right removal and exclusion.

services.title: Snake Removal
services.text: Snakes get into garages, attics and crawl spaces looking for shelter or prey. We find where they are active and provide professional snake removal.

services.title: Skunk Removal
services.text: Skunks often shelter under homes, decks and sheds. We find active areas and access points and give recommendations to help prevent repeat activity.

services.title: Bird Removal
services.text: Birds nest in vents, rooflines, attics and other openings. We find nesting and entry areas and provide bird removal and exclusion when appropriate.

services.title: Dead Animal Removal
services.text: Dead animals in attics, walls or crawl spaces cause strong odors and sanitation concerns. We locate accessible remains, remove them and identify related wildlife activity.

services.title: Wildlife Exclusion
services.text: Removing the animal alone does not stop future problems. Exclusion seals rooflines, vents, soffits, gaps and other entry points so animals cannot return and re-nest.
points: One-way doors let wildlife leave without getting back in
Final review once activity is resolved

groups.title: Attic Restoration
groups.summary: Contaminated insulation removal, sanitation, sealing and new insulation that closes the door on wildlife re-entry.
groups.intro: Wildlife droppings, urine and odors soak into attic insulation and structure. We remove contaminated insulation, disinfect the affected areas, seal entry points and install new insulation only after wildlife and rodent activity is fully resolved. Our standard: exclusion, insulation removal, decontamination, then new insulation.

services.title: Contaminated Insulation Removal
services.text: Rodent and wildlife activity contaminates insulation with droppings, urine, nesting material and odors. We remove the affected insulation and debris to prepare the attic for decontamination.

about.title: Do it right the first time, every time.
text: At The Restoration Attics, we exist to raise the standard for what homeowners should expect from wildlife control, attic restoration and pest solutions. We saw too many companies rushing jobs, cutting corners and offering temporary fixes disguised as solutions.

Houston homes face their own challenges, from wildlife intrusions to moisture, insulation damage and long-term contamination. Our team is trained to look deeper, seal tighter and restore smarter, so our work prevents re-entry, protects the structure and improves the health of the home.
We communicate clearly, show up when we say we will and stand behind our work. Every project is treated as if it were our own home.

faqs.q: What wildlife animals do you remove from homes and attics?
faqs.a: We provide professional wildlife removal for rats, mice, bats, raccoons, squirrels, possums and snakes commonly found in Houston attics, walls, crawl spaces and structures.

faqs.q: What damage can wildlife cause inside an attic?
faqs.a: Torn insulation, chewed electrical wiring, damaged ductwork, roof and soffit entry damage, nesting debris, droppings, urine contamination and strong odors. Many animals also create fire hazards and structural issues when activity goes unnoticed.

faqs.q: Do you repair the damage caused by wildlife?
faqs.a: Yes. Wildlife removal includes repairing entry points, sealing rooflines, vents, soffits and other access areas, and addressing damage that lets animals re-enter. Where there is contamination, attic restoration and insulation removal may also be recommended.

faqs.q: Why is wildlife exclusion necessary after removal?
faqs.a: Removing the animal alone does not stop future problems. Wildlife exclusion permanently seals entry points to prevent animals from returning, re-nesting and causing repeated damage.

faqs.q: What does your Pest Proof Protection Plan (PPPP) cover in Houston?
faqs.a: Common Houston household pests including ants, roaches, spiders, silverfish, crickets, earwigs, fleas, mosquitoes, wasps, and rodent control for rats and mice.

faqs.q: Does your pest control plan include rodent control?
faqs.a: Yes. Rodent control is part of our pest management services. Rats and mice are common in Houston and often need consistent monitoring, exclusion and control to prevent attic and structural issues.

faqs.q: How often should pest control be done in Houston, monthly or bi-monthly?
faqs.a: Houston's heat, humidity and long pest season let insects and rodents reproduce year-round. Monthly or bi-monthly pest control is far more effective than quarterly service, which lets pest populations rebound between visits.

faqs.q: Are bed bugs and German roaches included in regular pest control?
faqs.a: No. Bed bugs and German roaches need specialized, intensive treatments and are handled as separate clean-out services.

faqs.q: Can you install new insulation right away after contamination is found?
faqs.a: New insulation is best installed after the source is resolved and the attic is secured. Otherwise contamination and activity can return and compromise the new material.

faqs.q: What is the process for insulation removal and attic decontamination?
faqs.a: Attic inspection, then exclusion, then removal of contaminated insulation with proper equipment, then sanitizing the attic, then new insulation once the space is ready.

faqs.q: Can rodent urine and feces in insulation affect indoor air quality?
faqs.a: Yes. Contaminated insulation can contribute to ongoing odors and airborne contamination, especially when attic air moves through gaps and ventilation pathways.

faqs.q: When should contaminated attic insulation be removed?
faqs.a: When it's contaminated by feces, urine, droppings, nesting material and persistent odors, because contamination can linger and keep affecting the attic.
